## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; Communication, Consumer Staples and Industrials leading while Technology is lagging. Leadership concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5); style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads: VZ (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +16.12%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +16.65% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +16.26% | 1M: +1.65%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: FDX (1W: +13.13% | 1M: +20.57%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.01% | 1M: +17.73%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples steady: PEP (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +14.50%) ABOVE TREND, WMT (1W: +9.21% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology weakest: MSFT (1W: -14.43% | 1M: -13.05%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -11.57% | 1M: -20.76%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -14.07% | 1M: -22.57%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare under pressure: TMO (1W: -8.63% | 1M: -3.78%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -14.79%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -7.12%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft: BKNG (1W: -9.87% | 1M: -12.75%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -2.07% | 1M: -3.68%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -2.48% | 1M: +5.35%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VZ (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +16.12%) ABOVE TREND; T (1W: +16.65% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND; CHTR (1W: +16.26% | 1M: +1.65%) ABOVE TREND; TXN (1W: +15.28% | 1M: +27.69%) ABOVE TREND; FDX (1W: +13.13% | 1M: +20.57%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5), signaling selective strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: TMO (1W: -8.63% | 1M: -3.78%) BELOW TREND; ISRG (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -14.79%) BELOW TREND; BKNG (1W: -9.87% | 1M: -12.75%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -11.57% | 1M: -20.76%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -12.54% | 1M: -7.21%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in software/tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: VZ (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +16.12%), T (1W: +16.65% | 1M: +10.52%), CHTR (1W: +16.26% | 1M: +1.65%). Major divergence present across large caps (AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +4.34% | 1M: -0.56%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -14.43% | 1M: -13.05%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -4.51%)) — treat moves as tactical, not unanimous market direction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak; select hardware/chip names outperform while software names lag. TXN (1W: +15.28% | 1M: +27.69%) ABOVE TREND and INTC (1W: +12.11% | 1M: +25.06%) ABOVE TREND show strength, while MSFT (1W: -14.43% | 1M: -13.05%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -11.57% | 1M: -20.76%) BELOW TREND and CRM (1W: -14.07% | 1M: -22.57%) BELOW TREND indicate internal rotation within the sector.

8. Financials Outlook?
Cautious recovery in card and bank names with mixed 1M performance. JPM RECOVERY (1W: +4.84% | 1M: -2.83%), MA RECOVERY (1W: +5.82% | 1M: -2.06%), V RECOVERY (1W: +1.13% | 1M: -5.07%) show short‑term strength but sector 1M is soft.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Patchy: defensive JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.86% | 1M: +12.42%) but several names under pressure. TMO (1W: -8.63% | 1M: -3.78%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -14.79%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -7.12%) BELOW TREND highlight dispersion; watch for news-driven swings.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and commodity/industrial exposures showing confirmed ABOVE TREND momentum (CAT (1W: +10.01% | 1M: +17.73%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +17.19%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +14.20%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +13.13% | 1M: +20.57%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to large-cap software names showing structural weakness (MSFT BELOW TREND, ORCL BELOW TREND, CRM BELOW TREND) and monitor for trend confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +12.11% | 1M: +25.06%) ABOVE TREND — news flow confirms; TXN (1W: +15.28% | 1M: +27.69%) ABOVE TREND — momentum to watch; LLY (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -7.12%) BELOW TREND — positive guidance but price lagging, watch follow-through. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -14.43% | 1M: -13.05%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -11.57% | 1M: -20.76%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -24.88% | 1M: -28.28%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication, Industrials, Energy (breadth supportive across cyclicals). BEARISH: Technology, Healthcare, Consumer Discretionary (watch for earnings/news to widen dispersion).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor MSFT: failure to reclaim last 1W swing would deepen BELOW TREND and signal further downside. Watch AAPL (1W: +4.34% | 1M: -0.56%) RECOVERY — sustained weekly gains would confirm a recovery. NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -4.51%) BELOW TREND needs follow‑through above the recent 1W high to arrest the downtrend.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+80): Eli Lilly sees 2026 profit above estimates — LLY (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -7.12%) BELOW TREND, bullish news diverging from price, watch for follow‑through. ISRG (+80): FDA cardiac clearance expands opportunity — ISRG (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -14.79%) BELOW TREND, positive catalyst but price not confirming. INTC (+60): Apple foundry talks and alliances — INTC (1W: +12.11% | 1M: +25.06%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming price action.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CRM (-45): AI/software selloff headline — CRM (1W: -14.07% | 1M: -22.57%) BELOW TREND, news confirms weakness. NOW (-45): similar software pressure — NOW (1W: -16.71% | 1M: -25.55%) BELOW TREND, confirmed. UNH (-55): Medicare/headline risk — UNH (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -15.52%) RECOVERY, negative news diverging from short‑term price; watch for policy impact.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with Value/Cyclical style. XOM (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +17.19%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.01% | 1M: +17.73%) ABOVE TREND and TXN (1W: +15.28% | 1M: +27.69%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Major divergence among megacaps (MSFT BELOW TREND, AAPL RECOVERY, NVDA BELOW TREND) and bullish news on LLY (+80) despite LLY BELOW TREND are key risks to monitor.
